subject: general
question:
Complete the sentence using the options given below.

The short-run marginal cost curve is 'U'-shaped due to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**the law of variable proportions.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The short-run marginal cost curve is U-shaped in the short-run **due to the operation of the "law of variable proportions".**
 
• According to the law,** the MC curve initially slopes downward till it reaches its minimum point and thereafter, it starts rising.**
 
• Therefore, it leads to a U-shape of the curve when presented graphically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A marginal cost curve is a curve that graphically represents the relation between the marginal cost incurred by a firm in the short-run product of a good or service and the quantity of output produced.
 
• This curve is constructed to capture the relation between marginal cost and the level of output, holding other variables like technology and resource prices constant.
 
• Three related curves are the average total cost curve, average variable cost curve, and average fixed cost curve.
